'''Fudbalski klub Tekstilac Derventa''' ({{lang-sr-cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Teкcтилaц Дepвeнтa}}) is a professional [[association football]] club from the town of [[Derventa]], [[Republika Srpska]] that is situated in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Tekstilac currently plays in the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]] and plays its home matches on the Derventa City Stadium which has a capacity of 1,500 seats."}}
